rows.name: Merck & Co.
rows.thesis: Low-valuation large pharma with strong 12-month momentum (+67%), trading about 15% above its 200-day average; it adds defensive Health Care exposure.
rows.risks: Pressure on Keytruda's patent cliff or a pipeline setback in the earnings update.

rows.name: Targa Resources
rows.thesis: Fee-based midstream company at a new 52-week high, with low volatility and steady volume growth from the Permian.
rows.risks: A drop in Permian activity or a broad energy selloff.

rows.name: Nucor
rows.thesis: Leading US steelmaker with tariff protection and strong 12-month momentum, trading above its 200-day average.
rows.risks: Steel prices rolling over as industrial demand slows.

rows.name: CrowdStrike
rows.thesis: Leader in endpoint and cloud security; it confirmed its strength this week with a 13% rebound and is well above its 200-day average.
rows.risks: A rich valuation leaves no room for a disappointing quarter.

rows.name: Marathon Petroleum
rows.thesis: Best-in-class refiner benefiting from wide crack spreads and large buybacks; +17% over one month.
rows.risks: Refining margins normalizing after the third-quarter report.

rows.name: NetApp
rows.thesis: Storage company benefiting from AI data infrastructure at a reasonable valuation; it is holding up while its hardware peers sell off.
rows.risks: The AI hardware selloff spreading to its shares.

rows.name: Illumina, Inc.
rows.thesis: Sequencing leader in a sharp turnaround (+171% over 12 months) as demand and margins recover.
rows.risks: High volatility and possible China or competitive setbacks.

rows.name: DuPont
rows.thesis: Simplified DuPont after its spinoff, with low volatility and a strong trend; electronics and water units give it quality exposure.
rows.risks: Weak industrial demand hitting its guidance.

rows.name: Viatris
rows.thesis: Cheap generic-drug maker near its 52-week high, with steady cash flow and a defensive profile.
rows.risks: Generic price erosion or regulatory problems at its plants.

rows.name: Valero Energy
rows.thesis: Low-cost refiner with high cash returns; it diversifies the refining position alongside Marathon.
rows.risks: Margin normalization and too much combined energy exposure.

rows.name: Keysight Technologies
rows.thesis: Test and measurement leader with exposure to AI networking, 6G and defense; its 12-month trend is still strong.
rows.risks: It is on its 200-day average and moving with the falling AI hardware complex; I would sell if it breaks down further.

rows.name: Fortinet
rows.thesis: Profitable security vendor whose firewall refresh cycle is under way; strong 12-month momentum and well above its 200-day average.
rows.risks: Firewall demand being pulled forward, which would lead to slower billings.

rows.name: Morgan Stanley
rows.thesis: High-quality wealth management franchise supported by capital-markets activity; it is a small position to diversify into Financials.
rows.risks: It is the weakest holding and below its 200-day average; first in line to be sold if it keeps lagging.
